entries.name: sonner
entries.title: Sonner
entries.note: Dependency-free Toast-compatible entry: keeps Sonner's Toaster and toast() names on top of RemixCN's toast, without the sonner or next-themes packages. Upstream's Sonner docs page redirects to Toast.

helpers.name: theme
helpers.title: Theme
helpers.note: The global stylesheet every component needs: the cascade layer order, shadcn's Neutral theme as light and dark tokens, the type, space, radius, shadow and motion tokens, and a small reset. Link it first in the document head.

helpers.name: styles
helpers.title: Style conventions
helpers.note: Style objects for css(): focus ring, invalid and disabled states, visually hidden text, transitions and right-to-left mirroring, translated from the shared classes of shadcn's styles.

helpers.name: icons
helpers.title: Icons
helpers.note: Replaces shadcn's icon placeholder, which loads an icon library, with small original inline SVG icons and the Icon wrapper for your own.

helpers.name: aria
helpers.title: ARIA states
helpers.note: Writes boolean aria-* props as "true" or "false". Remix's server writes a boolean attribute as a bare name, which ARIA reads as false, so a control that passes your ARIA props through writes them as strings.

helpers.name: highlighter
helpers.title: Syntax highlighter
helpers.note: Not shipped: shadcn's highlighter loads Shiki, a package, and RemixCN source adds none. Run any highlighter you like, such as on the server, and pass its tokens to CodeBlockLine's tokens prop; splitTokenLines() in code-block.tsx splits them into lines. docs/components/code-block.md shows how.

helpers.name: use-highlighted-code
helpers.title: Highlighted code
helpers.note: Not shipped: a React hook around the Shiki highlighter. Its native equivalent is CodeBlockLine's tokens prop with splitTokenLines() from code-block.tsx, which take the tokens of any highlighter you run. docs/components/code-block.md shows how.
